reviewNotes: All 45 candidate decisions, contexts and rationales were read against their source passages and the exact local definitions.

Retained topic-diversion labels identify actual unanswered challenges rather than mere disagreement. The telepathy testing exception lacks independent support for the convenient laboratory restriction.

The vivid dream anecdote separately neglects background rates and treats felt specificity as validation; these are distinct mechanisms. Unlike Blackmore's qualified phenomenological report, Kastrup says the coincidence is too specific to dismiss.
Confirmation-bias labels describe observable selective interpretation and asymmetrical revision conditions; they are not diagnoses of either participant.

Rejected labels remain fully preserved in the anonymous adjudication output and original blind tables. All substantive limitations remain visible in unchanged critiques, whether or not a catalog label fits.
